title: The wellbeing day
summary: The physio is running a wellbeing day for the academy, about the weeks when a player isn't all right. She asks you to talk about the team-mate in the car, and what you did when you noticed.

ends.title: You spoke
ends.text: You talked to the academy about the team-mate in the car. Two lads knocked on the physio's door that week.

ends.title: You listened
ends.text: You sat at the back of the wellbeing day and didn't speak. A lad sat next to you at lunch and did.

beats.title: The wellbeing day

event.title: The wellbeing day
event.speaker: physio
setup: {physio.short} has a sheet of paper with the day on it: nine o'clock, the academy, forty lads. "I want you to talk about the car park. What you noticed, and what you did. Ten minutes."

say: "They listen to players. They don't listen to me."

replies.label: "Ten minutes. I'll tell them all of it."
"I'll come. I can't talk about it."

talk.text: Forty lads in a room that smells of sandwiches. You talk for twelve minutes. Nobody looks at their phone.

back.text: You sit at the back. At lunch a lad sits next to you and talks about his dad for half an hour.

beats.hint: The physio wants you to talk at the academy

beats.title: Her door

event.title: Her door
event.speaker: physio
setup: A season on. There's a sign on the physio's door now: KNOCK, about anything.

outcomes.text: "Two of them knocked the week after you spoke. One still does."
"The lad from lunch knocked. He said you listened."
She laughs and puts the kettle on. "About anything," she says.
She puts the kettle on. You talk about nothing for ten minutes and feel better.

beats.hint: A season on, the physio's door
